complaints.problem: It invokes "The Austrian drowning rescue" even though no Austrian rescue is introduced or described anywhere in the chapter, so this supposedly standalone layer contains an unresolved external referent. Reserved category: STRUCTURALLY INVALID.
Seven correct choices are uniquely longest, while many distractors use conspicuous blame, harder-work, central-command, or absolute-language straw men; the quiz is derivable but highly guessable.
The scenario stops at Emily's decision and prescribes an action without showing the action's observed consequence, so it lacks a full before-to-after demonstration.
The scenario identifies the missing owner but ends before showing whether assigning one prevents delay or shutdown.
Ingrid reconstructs the path, but the example never identifies the actual failed crossing or the consequence of her diagnosis.
The launch is paused in the recommendation, but the narrative provides no resulting headcount correction or safety outcome.
The example recommends dependency statements but never shows the restarted move or whether the artifact's exposure is reduced.
Hadiya labels and assigns the overlap in principle, but no subsequent storm outcome demonstrates that the intervention works.
The seam/ownership claim is restated several times with limited additional mechanism, slightly reducing density after the core idea is already clear.
The title and opening of the Core skill repeat "Learn to see the seam before you judge the people" verbatim, creating avoidable scaffold-like repetition.

parsedReview.oneParagraphVerdict: This is a strong, beginner-friendly chapter built around a memorable and transferable diagnostic move: when capable people miss a step, inspect the handoff before blaming an individual. Its imagery, practical prompts, varied domains, explicit limits, and concise mechanism are professionally effective. The main craft weaknesses are a quiz whose keys are often exposed by length and straw-man distractors, plus six examples that prescribe decisions without showing observed consequences. More seriously, the deep read refers to an Austrian drowning rescue that the chapter never introduces, breaking that layer's standalone promise; because that structural defect remains on the page, I would not ship this version despite its otherwise high quality.
